description: This file defines the interface 'ContentWorkerInterface' which declares methods related to content processing, rendering, and retrieval within the Apache OFBiz project.

classes.name: ContentWorkerInterface
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for content manipulation, rendering, and retrieval in OFBiz.

methods.name: getCurrentContentExt
methods.description: Retrieves the current content extension based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: getWebSitePublishPointExt
methods.description: Fetches the publishing point for a website given its content ID.

methods.name: getMimeTypeIdExt
methods.description: Determines the MIME type ID for a given content view.

methods.name: renderContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders content as plain text, writing directly to an Appendable.

methods.name: renderContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Render content as text and return as String.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Render sub-content as text, writing directly to an Appendable.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Render sub-content as text and return as String.
